packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch/digest/pin updates (branch protection still requires green CI)
Require manual approval for major updates
Cluster images/charts: manifests are applied by hand, so a merge would only drift git from the cluster. Open weekly grouped PRs as a to-do, never auto-merge.

Hive images: the hive-operator's HiveRelease `hive` (Enforce, track v6-latest) rolls the spokes and the hub, so the digests in the spoke manifests are not deployable state. ccleft's is bumped by hand (see its comment).
